messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is achieved by placing 12 points on the boundary at rational fractions (specifically (i/4, j/4) for i,j in {0,4} with suitable edge selections) and one point at the center (1/2, 1/2), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/28. This configuration forces every triangle to either use three boundary points with determinant divisible by 4 (area at least 1/8) or to use the center point with two boundary points, where the minimum is achieved by pairs like (0,1/4) and (1,1/2) spanning an area of 1/28. No arrangement of 13 points can exceed this minimum, making 1/28 the exact maximum."}
